question: Does the independently documented 2021 switch of SOXX and SOXL from PHLX to ICE coincide with a material change in their measured daily SOXL-minus-three-times-SOXX tracking residual or five-session relative payoff distribution, warranting a new Stage1 training-domain mechanism?
source_clock_reason: SOXX filing says on or around June 21 and SOXL filing says on or about August 25; use a one-week early buffer for the pre period and begin the common post period after the August 27 ICE listing confirmation. Preserve transition dates unknown, not assigned to either comparator.

measures.daily_simple_tracking_residual: soxl_forward_open_return - 3*soxx_forward_open_return on identical Qlib price-plane intervals, no fees or raw-share claim
measures.H5_log_relative_payoff: sum of five consecutive daily log-relative payoffs, only where all five are finite and label is mature; never use as a decision feature
measures.controls: For each regime report SOXX simple return mean and volatility, residual mean/median/std/absolute median/5-percent tail, log-relative mean and positive fraction, H5 log-relative mean and positive fraction. Retain complete annual, quarter and chronological daily matrices in Qlib Recorder; endpoint years marked partial. No threshold or sign selected from groups.

maturity: Use original timing.return_available_at for H1 and fifth-interval time for H5. Training labels must be mature before 2023-01-01 New York; held H5 before 2026-10-10 New York. Transition rows are retained but excluded from pre/post summaries.
decision_boundary: Descriptive source-aligned domain diagnosis, not an index-change causal effect, predictive feature or strategy. A new Stage1 0bp mechanism requires separately frozen model/receiver and own-state Tiered account with SOXX v2 gates; do not switch to a post-change parent by retrospective selection.
